  <div class="ws-instruction">
    Run this only once a bundle exists, and not on the same day as surface A. For each of the three properties, apply the book's test to the real bundle and record the result, how you tested it, your name and the date.
    Mark pass, partial or fail; nothing rolls up. If a row is not a pass, name the gap and who owns it.
  </div>

    <h2>Surface B &mdash; the acceptance test <span class="ws-block-note">three fixed rows, one per stated property</span></h2>

      <colgroup>

          <th><span class="fno">5</span> B7 If not pass &mdash; the gap and its owner</th>
        </tr>

        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="prior">It is composed, not stacked<span class="prior-src">ch27 L229</span></td>
          <td class="prior">Each primitive has a single concern and depends explicitly on what it builds on, so the bundle has a dependency graph rather than a flat list.<span class="prior-src">ch27 L229</span></td>
